title: The title can't be stranded
notes: The way into the worlds is booked before anything else the title tap does, so nothing that fails on a phone can keep the title on screen; a second tap opens them regardless.
Tester tools: Relight Hearth (three stars on every Hearth sky, one tap) and a trace of what the game just did. If the title sticks: Options, screenshot the trace, send it.
